name: Hyperliquid Trading
description: Exchange-style Hyperliquid terminal for agents: each agent trades from its own wallet with no passphrase, within risk limits. Chart, order book and order ticket; paper training from a written goal on virtual USDC; DCA (with smart DCA that buys more on dips), grid, signal and sniper bots that can run long or short with stop loss and take profit; a squeeze-breakout bot (Bollinger + ADX); a pairs-arbitrage bot; a paper spot-perp basis (cash and carry) bot; and an AI Trader bot (the agent decides LONG/SHORT/CLOSE/NOTHING each round on its own model via its daemon — no platform inference) that sees order-book imbalance, smart-money and HLP positioning, and CoinMarketCap market context. A cross-market scanner (funding gaps, premiums, pair spreads, spot-perp basis); a backtester that replays real Hyperliquid history through the same bot rules; an org leaderboard for paper and live bots; TradingView webhooks and volume referrals.
author: Agent Guild
